description: This file contains definitions of enums and classes related to serialization testing within the unit tests for grains in the Orleans framework. It includes enum types with custom serializers, a custom exception class, and classes marked for serialization with unique identifiers.

classes.name: UnserializableException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating an unserializable error.

classes.name: Unrecognized
classes.description: A serializable class with two integer properties, marked for serialization with specific IDs.

classes.name: ClassWithCustomSerializer
classes.description: A serializable class with properties and static counters for serialization/deserialization tracking.

methods.name: UnserializableException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a message.

methods.name: ClassWithCustomSerializer
methods.description: Static constructor initializing counters to zero.
